instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: SaaS InnovateFlow Solutions develops cloud-based workflow automation tools tailored for mid-sized enterprises in the professional services sector. The company focuses on providing scalable, efficient solutions to streamline internal processes like project management and client reporting.
answers.pastInitiatives: They recently launched a modular feature update based on direct customer requests to improve user adoption metrics and invested moderately in refining their core platform architecture.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is maintaining market share against larger competitors by focusing on deep integration capabilities. We aim to solidify our position as the most reliable workflow automation partner.
answers.teamSize: The core team consists of 8 highly skilled engineers and product managers, operating in a collaborative small leadership team structure.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Analytics Module
opportunities.rationale: Integrating predictive analytics into the workflow engine will allow us to move from reactive task management to proactive risk identification for clients, enhancing retention and defense against feature parity with larger competitors.

first_actions: Pilot a machine learning model on existing usage data
Define MVP features focusing on churn prediction metrics
execution_plan.success_metric: 30% reduction in customer churn rate within Q4.
milestones: Q3: Internal beta release and feedback incorporation

opportunities.title: Vertical-Specific Ecosystem Expansion (Niche AI Integrations)
opportunities.rationale: To defend market share, we must create unique value propositions that competitors cannot easily replicate. Developing proprietary integrations specific to high-growth niches will establish a defensible moat and attract new enterprise segments.

first_actions: Identify two non-core vertical markets (e.g., specialized construction or legal tech)
Form a cross-functional 'Defense Squad' focused solely on these integrations
resources_needed: Market research budget for niche validation
execution_plan.success_metric: Acquire 5 anchor clients in new vertical within 18 months.
milestones: Q4: First revenue generation from niche segment

opportunities.title: Enhanced Customer Success Automation
opportunities.rationale: Improving the onboarding experience and providing automated, personalized support channels will reduce customer time-to-value and reinforce loyalty, which is crucial for market defense.

first_actions: Implement an advanced knowledge base using LLMs
Automate proactive check-ins based on usage patterns
resources_needed: Slight increase in customer service headcount (1 FTE)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase Net Promoter Score (NPS) by 10 points.
milestones: Q2: Knowledge base fully deployed and tested
Q3: Full rollout across the user base

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated 'Market Defense' task force to define top 3 competitive vulnerabilities.
Begin feasibility study and resource allocation for the AI-Driven Predictive Analytics Module (Opportunity 1).
Conduct a comprehensive review of current talent pipeline against future strategic needs.

key_weaknesses: High reliance on core product feature updates rather than platform innovation.
Limited budget allocation for long-term R&D and radical exploratory projects.
Key technical talent retention risk due to competition from larger tech firms.
